body:
```suggestion
Enum moved to AccessibilityServer. Compatibility methods registered.
```
These are not real compatibility methods, but cast function pointers. I guess it _should_ be fine if the two enums are layout-compatible, but does someone know for sure this doesn't cause UB?
It should be fine, GDExtension API use plain `int64_t` for the enums (and enums are the same, so size would be the same size even if it was not), so cast is just for hints in the API JSON.

body: Should be an absolute path and together with the main block of includes (next to `servers/display/display_server_headless.h`).

It's arguably a lot of code churn adding an `_enums.h` file for AccessibilityServer which just benefits this one include. But it's a massive one so it's worth it.

In https://github.com/akien-mga/godot/commit/057cb2646ca31a60e1faa98f4fc5a509c23274c2 I had moved only the LiveMode enum to `display_server_enums.h`. But I suppose it makes sense to be consistent and move everything, and this further entrenches the concept that Server singletons now come with a ServerEnums namespace to keep simple enums needed in headers separate from the full API.
